steps.content: Too much. It's too much. Suffocated, you feel like your consciousness is being violated by another world.

This is not suppression by the Corpus or the Black Ring, but the heavy pressure from death itself. As if warned by instinct, before the shackles are fully formed, your body lets go of Oak Casket's hand, stepping back.
The woman opens her eyes slowly. The chaotic noise is banished instantly. The rain of filth dwindles. You no longer see the burning contamination.
Oak Casket simply sits there as if entirely unaware of the confrontation just now, murmuring something.

steps.speaker: Oak Casket
steps.content: Rest in peace... There will be no more suffering. Neither the long nightmares nor that miserable life will ever torment you again. You have received eternal salvation.
After a long while, she finally lifts her gaze from the void to look at you and the Sinners next to you.

steps.speaker: Oak Casket
steps.content: You've brought quite a few friends.

steps.speaker: Options
options: I don't mean to intrude, but what happened was dangerous.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: They're both reliable Sinners who can protect everyone.

steps.speaker: Oak Casket
steps.content: Not only them... When I say friends, I don't mean only the living...
As she speaks, she looks behind Hella and gives a mischievous smile. Like getting an electric shock, Hella hops a bit and scurries to grab your hand.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: What the heck are you talking about! S-Stop making up stories! The MBCC is a s-scientific organization, we don't buy your superstitious bullshit!

steps.speaker: Oak Casket
steps.content: Haha, just kidding. You're all too tense. Relax, there's no danger here.

steps.speaker: Oak Casket
steps.content: Only some woeful but harmless cries. The deceased have too many grievances. I'm their only listener.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Are they the ones who've recently passed?

steps.speaker: Oak Casket
steps.content: After a person passes away, the Resonance they've left behind also dwindles with time. But since <color=#fb9259>its</color> return has brought about a kind of special resonance, many past voices have reemerged.

steps.speaker: Oak Casket
steps.content: It feels new. While listening, I got sucked into it accidentally.
Dazed as though she's just back from a very long journey, Oak Casket stands up after a long while and looks at you.

steps.speaker: Oak Casket
steps.content: Now, I'm back. How can I help you?
